steps.name: Verify File Integrity
steps.description: Check the file size and type to ensure it is a text file and not corrupted.

steps.name: Review File Content
steps.description: Read the file content to understand the purpose and context of the document.

steps.name: Identify Key Information
steps.description: Extract relevant information from the file, such as brake system components and inventory verification.

steps.name: Document Review Complete
steps.description: Confirm that the file has been thoroughly reviewed and all necessary information has been extracted.
